name: getcpu
synopsis: int getcpu(unsigned int *_Nullable cpu, unsigned int *_Nullable node);
description: The getcpu() system call retrieves the CPU and NUMA node on which the calling thread is currently running, writing them to the provided pointers if not NULL. The information may not remain current after the call due to potential CPU changes by the kernel.

parameters.name: cpu
parameters.description: Pointer to an unsigned int where the CPU number is stored, or NULL to ignore

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Pointer to an unsigned int where the NUMA node number is stored, or NULL to ignore

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Arguments point outside the calling process’s address space
